blocks.text: not ... any, no, none — inkorning uch yo'li

O'zbek tilida inkor gapda odatda **ikki** inkor so'z birga keladi: «Uyda **hech** non **yo'q**», «**Hech qanday** xat **olmadim**», «**Birorta ham** xato **qilmadi**». Ingliz tilida esa bitta gapda inkor **faqat bitta** bo'ladi. Shuning uchun bir fikrni ikki xil aytish mumkin: yo fe'l inkorda + **any** (There **isn't any** bread), yo fe'l tasdiqda + **no** (There's **no** bread). Ikkalasini birga qo'shib bo'lmaydi: «There isn't no bread» — xato.

Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato — o'zbekcha ikki inkorni inglizchaga ko'chirish: «I haven't got no money.» → **I haven't got any money.** yoki **I've got no money.**; «There isn't no milk.» → **There isn't any milk.** / **There's no milk.**; «We didn't see no buses.» → **We didn't see any buses.** Yana bir xato: «I have not money.» → **I have no money.** (**not** — fe'l bilan, **no** — ot bilan).

**no** doim ot oldida keladi va undan keyin fe'l **tasdiq** shaklida turadi, chunki inkor allaqachon **no** ning ichida. Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan **no** = **not any**, birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan **no** = **not a**. **no** ko'pincha **there is / there are** va **have (got)** bilan ishlatiladi. So'zlashuvda **not any** ko'proq eshitiladi, **no** esa biroz kuchliroq, qat'iyroq jaranglaydi.

items.text: There are **no** shops in this part of the city.
We had **no** problems with the car on the way to Samarkand.
items.translation: Samarqandga ketayotganda mashina bilan **hech qanday** muammo **bo'lmadi**.

blocks.text: **none** ham «hech qanday», «birortasi ham» degan ma'noni beradi, lekin u **otsiz**, yolg'iz ishlatiladi — ot oldin aytilgan bo'ladi. Solishtiring: There's **no** milk. — There's **none**. **no** + ot, **none** — ot o'rnida. «There's none milk» yoki «I've got no» deyilmaydi.

items.text: I wanted some juice, but there was **none** in the fridge.
items.translation: Sharbat ichmoqchi edim, lekin muzlatgichda **qolmagan** ekan.

items.text: Tom has three children, but his brother has **none**.
items.translation: Tomning uchta farzandi bor, akasining esa **birorta ham yo'q**.

items.text: We looked for a parking space, but there were **none**.
items.translation: Mashina qo'yishga joy qidirdik, lekin **birorta ham** bo'sh joy **yo'q** edi.

blocks.text: **How much ...?** va **How many ...?** savollariga qisqa javob sifatida **None.** juda qulay: How much money have you got? — **None.** («Umuman yo'q»). Kishilar haqida «Who ...?» savoliga esa **Nobody** / **No-one** deyiladi → 78-dars.

items.text: How many cousins have you got? — **None**.
How much bread is left? — **None**, I'm afraid.

blocks.text: Bog'liq mavzular: **some / any** → 76-dars; **nobody, nothing, nowhere** (xuddi shu «bitta inkor» qoidasi) → 78–79-darslar; **none of** the ... → 81-dars; ikki narsa haqida **neither** → 82-dars.
Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha gapda «**hech** ... **yo'q**» yoki «**hech** ... **-ma-**» bo'lsa, inglizchada **bittasini** tanlang: **not** + any YOKI **no**. Ot yo'q bo'lsa — **none**.

rows: tasdiq fe'l + ot (= not any / not a)
I wanted fruit, but there was **none**.

examples.title: There's **no** ... / There are **no** ...
examples.description: **no** + ot = **not any** + ot: There **isn't any** milk = There's **no** milk. **no** dan keyin fe'l tasdiqda turadi (is, are, was), chunki inkor allaqachon **no** da.

sentences.text: There's **no** milk in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda sut **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Sorry, there are **no** tickets left for tonight.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bugun kechaga chipta **qolmagan**.

sentences.text: In our village there's **no** cinema, so we watch films at home.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda kinoteatr **yo'q**, shuning uchun filmlarni uyda ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: There were **no** clouds in the sky, and the sea was warm.
sentences.translation: Osmonda **birorta ham** bulut **yo'q** edi, dengiz esa iliq edi.

sentences.text: We have to hurry — there's **no** time for breakfast.
sentences.translation: Shoshilishimiz kerak — nonushtaga **vaqt yo'q**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, there was **no** hot water in the hotel.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, mehmonxonada issiq suv **yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Is there a lift? — No, there's **no** lift, so we'll take the stairs.
sentences.translation: Lift bormi? — Yo'q, lift **yo'q**, zinadan chiqamiz.

sentences.text: On Sundays there are **no** classes, so the students sleep late.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari dars **bo'lmaydi**, shuning uchun talabalar kech uyg'onadi.

sentences.text: There's **no** need to bring food — we've got plenty.
sentences.translation: Ovqat olib kelishning **hojati yo'q** — bizda yetarli.

sentences.text: Why is the road so quiet? — Because there's **no** football match today.
sentences.translation: Ko'cha nega bunchalik jim? — Chunki bugun futbol o'yini **yo'q**.

examples.title: I've got **no** ... / We have **no** ...
examples.description: **have (got) no** + ot = **haven't got any** + ot: I've got **no** money = I haven't got **any** money. Fe'l tasdiqda — inkor faqat **no** da.

sentences.text: I've got **no** money until Friday.
sentences.translation: Jumagacha **hech pulim yo'q**.

sentences.text: Madina has **no** brothers, only two sisters.
sentences.translation: Madinaning aka-ukasi **yo'q**, faqat ikkita opa-singlisi bor.

sentences.text: We've got **no** bread, so I'm going to the bakery.
sentences.translation: Uyda **non yo'q**, shuning uchun nonvoyxonaga ketyapman.

sentences.text: Sorry, I have **no** idea where Tom is.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Tom qayerdaligini **umuman bilmayman**.

sentences.text: The new flat has **no** balcony, but the rooms are big.
sentences.translation: Yangi kvartiraning **balkoni yo'q**, lekin xonalari katta.

sentences.text: Bekzod had **no** time for lunch yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha Bekzodning tushlikka **hech vaqti bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: My grandparents had **no** phone when they were young.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim yosh paytida ularning **telefoni yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: The museum has **no** café, so bring a sandwich with you.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda **kafe yo'q**, shuning uchun o'zingiz bilan sendvich olib keling.

sentences.text: Emma has got **no** experience, but she learns quickly.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **hech qanday tajribasi yo'q**, lekin u tez o'rganadi.

sentences.text: The poor cat has **no** home — shall we take it?
sentences.translation: Bechora mushukning **uyi yo'q** — uni olib ketaylikmi?

examples.title: **no** + singular noun = not **a**
examples.description: Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan **no** = **not a**: There's **no** lift = There **isn't a** lift. I've got **no** pen = I haven't got **a** pen. Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan ot bilan esa **no** = **not any**.

sentences.text: Sorry I'm late — there was **no** bus for forty minutes.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kechikdim — qirq daqiqa **avtobus bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has **no** car, so she goes to work by metro.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning **mashinasi yo'q**, shuning uchun ishga metroda boradi.

sentences.text: This room has **no** window — it's very dark.
sentences.translation: Bu xonada **deraza yo'q** — juda qorong'i.

sentences.text: The village has **no** hospital, only a small clinic.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda **kasalxona yo'q**, faqat kichik poliklinika bor.

sentences.text: I can't write it down — I've got **no** pen.
sentences.translation: Yozib ololmayman — **ruchkam yo'q**.

sentences.text: Is there a bank near here? — No, there's **no** bank, but there's a cash machine.
sentences.translation: Bu yaqinda bank bormi? — Yo'q, **bank yo'q**, lekin bankomat bor.

sentences.text: Thank you for your help! — **No** problem.
sentences.translation: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat! — **Arzimaydi**.

sentences.text: Aziz gave **no** answer to my question.
sentences.translation: Aziz savolimga **hech qanday javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: In 1990 my parents had **no** computer and **no** mobile phone.
sentences.translation: 1990-yilda ota-onamning **na kompyuteri, na mobil telefoni** bor edi.

sentences.text: Sarah lives in a small house with **no** garden, near the centre of Oxford.
sentences.translation: Sara Oksford markazi yaqinida, **bog'i yo'q** kichik uyda yashaydi.

examples.title: One negative only: **not any** or **no**
examples.description: O'zbekchada ikki inkor: «**hech** qanday ... **olmadim**». Inglizchada inkor faqat bitta: yo **not ... any**, yo **no**. «I didn't get no messages» — xato.

sentences.text: I didn't get **any** messages from Bekzod today.
sentences.translation: Bugun Bekzoddan **hech qanday** xabar **olmadim**.

sentences.text: The doctor found **no** problems with my heart.
sentences.translation: Shifokor yuragimda **hech qanday** muammo **topmadi**.

sentences.text: We haven't got **any** plans for the weekend yet.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlariga hali **hech qanday** rejamiz **yo'q**.

sentences.text: Our team scored **no** goals in the second half.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz ikkinchi bo'limda **birorta ham** gol **urmadi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, this course won't cost you **any** money.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, bu kurs uchun **hech qancha** pul **to'lamaysiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah has **no** time for hobbies these days.
sentences.translation: Sara hozir sevimli mashg'ulotlariga **umuman vaqt topolmaydi**.

sentences.text: The shop didn't have **any** bread, so I bought some biscuits.
sentences.translation: Do'konda **hech** non **qolmagan** ekan, shuning uchun pechenye oldim.

sentences.text: Madina made **no** mistakes in her English test.
sentences.translation: Madina ingliz tili testida **birorta ham** xato **qilmadi**.

sentences.text: They didn't give us **any** information about the delay.
sentences.translation: Bizga kechikish haqida **hech qanday** ma'lumot **berishmadi**.

sentences.text: There was **no** food at home, and the shops were closed.
sentences.translation: Uyda **hech qanday** ovqat **yo'q** edi, do'konlar esa yopiq edi.

examples.title: **none** — without a noun
examples.description: **none** otsiz, yolg'iz ishlatiladi (ot oldin aytilgan): I wanted cake, but there was **none** left. **no** esa doim ot bilan: **no** cake.

sentences.text: I wanted a piece of cake, but there was **none** left.
sentences.translation: Bir bo'lak tort yemoqchi edim, lekin **hech qolmagan** ekan.

sentences.text: We looked for a taxi, but there were **none** at the station.
sentences.translation: Taksi qidirdik, lekin vokzalda **birorta ham** yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Aziz has five cousins, but I've got **none**.
sentences.translation: Azizning beshta amakivachchasi bor, menda esa **birorta ham yo'q**.

sentences.text: Emma asked for milk for her coffee, but there was **none** in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Emma qahvasiga sut so'radi, lekin muzlatgichda **sut yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Sarah expected some letters from home, but **none** came.
sentences.translation: Sara uydan xat kutgan edi, lekin **birortasi ham kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Madina tried to find a cheap flat in London, but there were **none**.
sentences.translation: Madina Londondan arzon kvartira topmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin **birortasi ham** yo'q edi.

sentences.text: We usually sell fresh bread, but today there's **none**.
sentences.translation: Odatda yangi non sotamiz, lekin bugun **umuman yo'q**.

sentences.text: Bekzod searched the internet for information about the village, but he found **none**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod internetdan qishloq haqida ma'lumot qidirdi, lekin **hech narsa topmadi**.

sentences.text: There used to be three bakeries in our street. Now there are **none**.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizda avval uchta nonvoyxona bor edi. Endi **birortasi ham yo'q**.

sentences.text: Mr Brown gave us homework every day, but Ms White usually gave us **none**.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun bizga har kuni uy vazifasi berardi, Uayt xonim esa odatda **hech qanday** vazifa **bermasdi**.

examples.title: Short answers: How many ...? — **None**.
examples.description: **How much ...?** / **How many ...?** savollariga qisqa javob — **None.** («birorta ham», «umuman»). Gap ichida ham **none** otsiz keladi.

sentences.text: How many eggs are left? — **None**. We need to buy some.
sentences.translation: Nechta tuxum qoldi? — **Birorta ham qolmadi**. Sotib olishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: And how much money did you spend in Samarkand? — **None** — my uncle paid.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda qancha pul sarfladingiz? — **Hech qancha** — amakim to'ladi.

sentences.text: Madina, how many mistakes did you make? — **None** at all!
sentences.translation: Madina, nechta xato qildingiz? — **Birorta ham**!

sentences.text: Is there any coffee left? — No, there's **none**. Shall I make some?
sentences.translation: Qahva qoldimi? — Yo'q, **umuman qolmagan**. Damlab beraymi?

sentences.text: Brothers or sisters? Tom has **none** — he's an only child.
sentences.translation: Aka-uka, opa-singil deysizmi? Tomning **hech kimi yo'q** — u yolg'iz farzand.

sentences.text: How many people came to the meeting? — **None**! It was a holiday.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishga necha kishi keldi? — **Hech kim**! Bayram kuni ekan.

sentences.text: Sugar? — **None** for me, thanks. I drink it without.
sentences.translation: Shakar-chi? — Menga **solmang**, rahmat. Shakarsiz ichaman.

sentences.text: Any questions before the test? — **None**, thank you.
sentences.translation: Testdan oldin savollar bormi? — **Yo'q**, rahmat.

sentences.text: James, how many cars have you got? — **None**. I cycle to work.
sentences.translation: Jeyms, nechta mashinangiz bor? — **Birortayam yo'q**. Ishga velosipedda boraman.

sentences.text: Bukhara needed rain in July, but there was **none**.
sentences.translation: Iyulda Buxoroga yomg'ir kerak edi, lekin **bir tomchi ham** yog'madi.

examples.title: At a hotel: There's **no** hot water!
examples.description: Mehmonxonadagi shikoyat: **no** + ot, **not any**, **none** va qisqa javob **None** — bitta suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Good evening. I'm in room 12, and there's **no** hot water.
sentences.translation: — Xayrli kech. Men 12-xonadaman, issiq suv **yo'q**.

sentences.text: — I'm sorry about that. Is there **any** cold water?
sentences.translation: — Uzr. Sovuq suv-chi, **bormi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but there aren't **any** towels in the bathroom either.
sentences.translation: — Bor, lekin vannaxonada **birorta ham** sochiq **yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Oh dear, I'm afraid there are **none** here at reception.
sentences.translation: — Voy, afsuski, qabulxonada ham **birortasi qolmagan**.

sentences.text: — And the TV doesn't work. There's **no** picture, only sound.
sentences.translation: — Televizor ham ishlamayapti. **Tasvir yo'q**, faqat ovoz bor.

sentences.text: — I'm very sorry. We've had **no** complaints about that room before.
sentences.translation: — Juda uzr. Ilgari bu xona haqida **hech qanday** shikoyat **bo'lmagan**.

sentences.text: — Well, are there **any** other free rooms tonight?
sentences.translation: — Unda bugun kechaga **boshqa bo'sh xona bormi**?

sentences.text: — Let me look... No, sorry. There are **no** free rooms tonight.
sentences.translation: — Bir qarayin... Yo'q, kechirasiz. Bugun **bo'sh xona yo'q**.

sentences.text: — **No** rooms at all? Not even a small one?
sentences.translation: — **Birorta ham** xona **yo'q**mi? Hatto kichigi ham?

sentences.text: — **None**, I'm afraid. But I'll bring you some towels in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, **birortayam**. Lekin o'n daqiqada sochiq olib kelaman.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **no**, **none** or **not any**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ot bilan **no**, otsiz **none**, inkor fe'l bilan **any** — har doim bitta inkor.

sentences.text: There's **no** sugar in this cake — it's made with honey.
sentences.translation: Bu tortda **shakar yo'q** — u asal bilan tayyorlangan.

sentences.text: I phoned three shops, but **none** had my size.
sentences.translation: Uchta do'konga qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin **birortasida ham** mening o'lchamim **yo'q** ekan.

sentences.text: We didn't see **any** snow in Tashkent last winter.
sentences.translation: O'tgan qish Toshkentda **umuman** qor **ko'rmadik**.

sentences.text: Aziz has **no** time to cook, so he usually eats at work.
sentences.translation: Azizning ovqat pishirishga **vaqti yo'q**, shuning uchun u odatda ishda ovqatlanadi.

sentences.text: Did you find **any** good photos for the website? — No, I didn't find **any**.
sentences.translation: Sayt uchun **biror** yaxshi surat topdingizmi? — Yo'q, **birortasini ham topmadim**.

sentences.text: I've got **no** cash on me — can I pay by card?
sentences.translation: Yonimda **naqd pulim yo'q** — karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: The bus was full, and there were **no** empty seats.
sentences.translation: Avtobus to'la edi, **birorta ham** bo'sh joy **yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Sarah wanted some advice, but her friends gave her **none**.
sentences.translation: Sara maslahat so'radi, lekin dugonalari unga **hech qanday** maslahat **bermadi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather doesn't use **any** social media, and he has **no** email address.
sentences.translation: Bobom **hech qanday** ijtimoiy tarmoqdan **foydalanmaydi**, elektron pochtasi ham **yo'q**.

sentences.text: I invited five friends to my birthday party, but **none** came because of the snow.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunimga beshta do'stimni chaqirdim, lekin qor tufayli **birortasi ham kelmadi**.
